recipes.title: Cottage Cheese & Parmesan Alfredo
recipes.blurb: Blender alfredo on cottage cheese and Parmesan. Silky, savory, high protein. Ten minutes, no cream.

steps.title: Combine
steps.text: Add {cc} cottage cheese, {parm} Parmesan, {garlic} garlic clove and {milk} high-protein milk (or water) to a blender.

steps.title: Blend
steps.text: Blend until completely smooth, no curds or grit. Scrape the sides once if needed.

steps.title: Season
steps.text: Taste, then season with salt and fresh black pepper.

steps.title: Bulk it up (optional)
steps.text: Fold cooked chicken or shrimp through the warmed sauce for a full dinner.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Toss with hot pasta, spoon over roasted vegetables, or use as a dip. Finish with more Parmesan.

omnicook_steps.title: Load the bowl
omnicook_steps.text: Add {cc} cottage cheese, {parm} Parmesan, {garlic} garlic clove and {milk} high-protein milk.

omnicook_steps.title: Blend smooth
omnicook_steps.text: Blend until no curds remain. Scrape down once.

omnicook_steps.title: Warm
omnicook_steps.text: Warm the sauce gently. Don't boil or the cheese can split.

omnicook_steps.title: Season + serve
omnicook_steps.text: Season with salt and pepper, fold in any cooked protein, and toss with hot pasta.

flags: Faint print: Parmesan and milk amounts read as fractions of a cup; using 1/2 cup and 1/4 cup.
Original was 250 g cottage cheese; shown as 1 cup (about 8.8 oz).

recipes.title: Pineapple Tepache
recipes.blurb: Mexican fermented pineapple drink. Fermented in a gallon jar. Lightly sweet and tangy.

yield.max_note: Capped by a 1-gallon jar; scaling up needs a second jar.

steps.title: Prep the pineapple
steps.text: Scrub {pine} pineapple well under running water. Cut off the top and bottom. Slice off the rind in thick strips. Keep the rind and core; set aside any flesh for eating.

steps.title: Make the syrup
steps.text: Dissolve {sugar} piloncillo or brown sugar in about 2 cups of warm filtered water, stirring until fully dissolved. Let cool slightly.

steps.title: Load the jar
steps.text: Add the pineapple rind, core, {cinn} cinnamon sticks, {clove} whole cloves, and any optional spices ({anise} star anise, {chile} chile de árbol, zest of {zest} lime or orange) to a clean gallon jar.

steps.title: Fill
steps.text: Pour in the sugar syrup, then fill to the shoulder with the rest of the {water} filtered water. Leave 2–3 inches of headspace.

steps.title: Cover loosely
steps.text: Cover with a clean cloth, cheesecloth, or the lid slightly cracked, never sealed tight. Secure with a rubber band.

steps.title: Ferment
steps.text: Ferment at room temperature (68–80°F) for 2–3 days. Stir or swirl once a day. Bubbles mean it's working.

steps.title: Taste + bottle
steps.text: Taste starting on day 2. It should smell fruity and slightly tangy. When you like it, strain out the solids, bottle, and refrigerate.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve chilled over ice. Drink within 1–2 weeks. Carbonation keeps building in the bottle, so burp the lids daily.

tips: The rind carries the wild yeast that starts fermentation, so don't skip it.
Riper pineapples and warmer kitchens ferment faster; check earlier in summer.
White foam on top is normal kahm yeast; skim it off.
Avoid sealed lids while fermenting; pressure builds fast.
Mix half tepache, half sparkling water for a lighter drink.
Use organic pineapple if you can. Avoid chlorinated tap water.

recipes.title: Yeasted Cottage Cheese Bagels
recipes.blurb: Max-size OmniCook batch: about 40 oz of dough.

omnicook_capacity.note: This recipe IS the max batch. In OmniCook mode the scaler caps at 1x; above that, split into two batches.

omnicook_steps.title: Activate the yeast
omnicook_steps.text: Add {water} warm water, {sugar} sugar or honey and {yeast} instant yeast. Then let it sit 5 minutes until lightly foamy.

omnicook_steps.title: Add dairy, fat and salt
omnicook_steps.text: Add {cc} cottage cheese, {oil} neutral oil and {salt} fine sea salt.

omnicook_steps.title: Build the dough
omnicook_steps.text: Add {flour} bread flour. Use the Kneading preset only; don't go past it (motor safety). If dry, add water 1 tsp at a time.

omnicook_steps.title: Bulk rise
omnicook_steps.text: Lightly oil a bowl, add the dough, cover. Rise at 75–78°F until about 1.5x in size.

omnicook_steps.title: Shape
omnicook_steps.text: Divide into 10 pieces of 4.2–4.4 oz (large) or 12 pieces of 3.4–3.6 oz (medium). Roll into tight balls and rest 10 minutes. Poke a hole and stretch to 2¼–3 inches.

omnicook_steps.title: Boil
omnicook_steps.text: Boil with {malt} barley malt syrup or honey and {soda} baking soda in the water. 30 seconds per side.

omnicook_steps.title: Bake
omnicook_steps.text: Bake at 425°F for 20–22 minutes.

omnicook_steps.title: Cool
omnicook_steps.text: Cool at least 30 minutes before slicing.

steps.title: Activate the yeast
steps.text: Stir {water} warm water, {sugar} sugar or honey and {yeast} instant yeast in a large bowl. Let sit 5 minutes until lightly foamy.

steps.title: Add dairy, fat and salt
steps.text: Mash in {cc} cottage cheese, {oil} neutral oil and {salt} fine sea salt until mostly smooth.

steps.title: Build the dough
steps.text: Add {flour} bread flour, mix, then knead by hand 8–10 minutes until smooth and elastic.

steps.title: Bulk rise
steps.text: Lightly oil the bowl, add the dough, cover. Rise at 75–78°F until about 1.5x in size.

steps.title: Shape

steps.title: Boil
steps.text: Boil with {malt} barley malt syrup or honey and {soda} baking soda in the water, 30 seconds per side.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake at 425°F for 20–22 minutes.

steps.title: Cool
steps.text: Cool at least 30 minutes before slicing.

recipes.title: Easy Homemade Bagels

steps.title: Activate yeast
steps.text: In a large bowl, mix {water} warm water and {sugar} sugar. Sprinkle {yeast} active dry yeast on top. Let sit 5–10 minutes until foamy.

steps.title: Mix dough
steps.text: Add {flour} bread flour and {salt} salt. Mix, then knead 8–10 minutes until smooth and elastic.

steps.title: First rise
steps.text: Place in a greased bowl, cover with a towel, rise 1 hour until doubled.

steps.title: Shape
steps.text: Punch down, divide into 8–10 pieces. Roll each into a ball, poke a hole in the center and stretch into a bagel shape.

steps.title: Second rise
steps.text: Rest on a floured surface, covered, 15–20 minutes.

steps.title: Boil
steps.text: Bring {boilwater} water and {honey} honey to a gentle boil. Boil each bagel 1–2 minutes per side. Remove with a slotted spoon to a lined sheet.

steps.title: Top
steps.text: Sprinkle toppings while still damp.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake at 425°F for 20–25 minutes until golden brown.

steps.title: Cool
steps.text: Cool on a wire rack before slicing.

omnicook_steps.title: Activate yeast
omnicook_steps.text: Add {water} warm water, {sugar} sugar and {yeast} yeast. Rest 5 minutes until foamy.

omnicook_steps.title: Knead
omnicook_steps.text: Add {flour} bread flour and {salt} salt. Kneading preset.

omnicook_steps.title: Rise, shape, boil, bake
omnicook_steps.text: Continue with First rise through Cool as written (off the machine).

tips: Bread flour gives a chewier texture.
Boiling is what makes the classic crust; don't skip it.
For extra shine, brush boiled bagels with egg wash before baking.
Store airtight up to 3 days, or freeze.
flags: Card's ounce figures for yeast (0.56 oz) and salt (0.6 oz) don't match 2¼ tsp and 1 tsp; using the spoon amounts.
OmniCook dough here is about 37 oz, near the 40 oz max.

steps.title: Base
steps.text: Whisk {garlic} garlic cloves, {anch} anchovy paste, {lemon} lemon juice, {dijon} Dijon and {worc} Worcestershire until smooth.

steps.title: Creamy
steps.text: Add {mayo} mayonnaise, {parm} Parmesan, {salt} salt and {pepper} pepper; whisk until creamy.

steps.title: Adjust
steps.text: Taste and adjust. Thin with 1–2 tsp water if needed.

recipes.title: Espresso Martini

steps.title: Shake
steps.text: Fill a shaker with ice. Add {esp} espresso, {vodka} vodka, {kahlua} Kahlúa and {syrup} simple syrup. Shake hard.

steps.title: Strain + garnish
steps.text: Strain into a martini glass and top with {beans} coffee beans.

flags: Card listed ingredients only; the two steps are standard method, added.
Card says '7 fl oz cup' for the espresso line; amount unclear.

recipes.title: Almond Flour Chocolate Chip Cookies
recipes.blurb: Gluten-free. Soft centers, golden edges. Mix in the OmniCook, fold chips by hand, bake in the oven.

omnicook_steps.title: Make the wet base
omnicook_steps.text: Heat off. Add {butter} softened butter, {brown} packed brown sugar, {gran} granulated sugar, {egg} and {vanilla} vanilla. Mix until smooth.

omnicook_steps.title: Add the dry
omnicook_steps.text: Add {almond} almond flour, {soda} baking soda and {salt} salt.

omnicook_steps.title: Scrape and pulse
omnicook_steps.text: Stop the blade, scrape down the bowl, then mix in 5-second bursts until just combined.

omnicook_steps.title: Fold in the chips
omnicook_steps.text: Move the dough to a bowl and stir in {chips} chocolate chips by hand.

omnicook_steps.title: Heat the oven
omnicook_steps.text: Heat the oven to 375°F. Line a baking sheet with parchment.

omnicook_steps.title: Scoop
omnicook_steps.text: Scoop and roll 1½-tbsp balls. Space them 2 inches apart.

omnicook_steps.title: Bake
omnicook_steps.text: Bake 10–11 minutes, until the edges are just slightly golden.

omnicook_steps.title: Cool
omnicook_steps.text: Cool on the sheet a few minutes, then move gently to a rack.

steps.title: Make the wet base

steps.title: Add the dry
steps.text: Stir in {almond} almond flour, {soda} baking soda and {salt} salt until just combined.

steps.title: Fold in the chips

tips: Don't wait for firm centers. Pull them when the edges are just golden; they keep setting on the hot sheet.
